text:
Gold Price in 1994
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1994, the LBMA gold price rose 1.4% between 1994-01-31 ($378) and 1994-12-29 ($383). The highest sampled price was $395 in September and the lowest was $376 in April. The mean of these observations was $385. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
